<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

final readonly class UserLoggedInData
{
    public function __construct(
        public string $email,
        public ?array $federatedClaims,
        public array $flowcatalystClaims,
        public ?string $identityProviderCode,
        public string $loginMethod,
        public string $userId,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<string, mixed> $data */
    public static function fromArray(array $data): self
    {
        return new self(
            email: $data['email'],
            federatedClaims: $data['federatedClaims'],
            flowcatalystClaims: $data['flowcatalystClaims'],
            identityProviderCode: $data['identityProviderCode'],
            loginMethod: $data['loginMethod'],
            userId: $data['userId'],
        );
    }

    /** @return array<string, mixed> */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        return [
            'email' => $this->email,
            'federatedClaims' => $this->federatedClaims,
            'flowcatalystClaims' => $this->flowcatalystClaims,
            'identityProviderCode' => $this->identityProviderCode,
            'loginMethod' => $this->loginMethod,
            'userId' => $this->userId,
        ];
    }
}
